title: Bipartite graphs, random graphs, and Lin--Lu--Yau curvature
summary: Let $G = (X, Y; E)$ be a bipartite graph with parts $X$ and $Y$ where $|X|=m$ and $|Y|=n$. We show that every bipartite graph with more than $mn - D(m,n)$ edges has positive Lin--Lu--Yau curvature, where $D(m,n)=m-2+\lceil{\frac {n}{2}\rceil} \text{ if $n\geq 2m$}, \mbox{and} \ n-1 \text{ if $m\leq n< 2m$}.$ We also show that every bipartite graph of order $m+n$ with $m \geq n$ and minimum degree at least $\min\{n, \lfloor{\frac{m+n}{3}\rfloor}+1\}$ has positive Lin--Lu--Yau curvature.
